text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"—That's all for today.
Great job on our first class of the new year!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Hayahideee!!
Looking forward to working with you this year too~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Congratulations, Ticket.
Though this is the third time we've had this conversation since this morning.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that so?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, oh well!
Hey, hey, Hayahide, which route did you choose!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"The Classic Triple Crown?
The Triple Tiara!?
I'm gonna—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown route, right? There's the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! How did you know?!
Yeah, you got it!!
My dream, the Derby is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously amazing! When I watched it with
my mom when I was little, everyone was going wild!

text_block_list.name: Young Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis!? What's wrong!?
Does your tummy hurt!?"

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
N-No... that's not it.
...I'm just so happy she won.

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text: Her Derby was my dream, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *sniffle*... *sob*... Everyone's dreams are packed into the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...How many times have you told that story now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha. That just shows how deeply you feel about the Derby, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonnna be a Derby Umamusume tooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Look, Ticket, your nose is running.
Do you have a tissue?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, which route did Hayahide end up choosing in the end?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course, the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, so all three of you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. I just stumbled a bit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You didn't skip breakfast,
did you? If you're not feeling well—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I told you I'm fine. I had a proper breakfast, too.
...So please, don't say things like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I know you were worried after seeing what happened
just now, Hayahide.
But even so... I really don't want to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't you give up on racing?
Your body is weak, isn't it? Even if you seek another path—

text_block_list.name: Elementary Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you seriously planning to go to Tracen Academy?
Do you really think you can make it in the Twinkle Series with such a tiny body?

text_block_list.name: Elementary Classmate B
text_block_list.text: A runt like you, whatever you do is useless anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Look. Whether it's the Classic Triple Crown
or taking on both of them, I'm gonna win."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There's no point unless I win.
To show up all those jerks who made fun of me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I know, Taishin.
I had a feeling you would declare that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, I won't lose either.
Whether it's Ticket or you,
I will face you with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Mm. That makes beating them all the more worthwhile.
First stop, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's meet at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And with that, Trainer-kun. This is our first meeting of the new year.
choice_data_list: Looking forward to another great year!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, I look forward to working with you.
...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then without further ado, let's move to the main topic.
My goal remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"To become an Umamusume who stands at the pinnacle."
An Umamusume second to none, that is.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. For that reason as well,
we need to hurry and complete the winning formula.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, what do you think is currently
missing from my winning formula?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Without further ado, shall we move on to our primary objective: the meeting?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Along with applying it in practice afterward as a full package, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I shared
a passionate discussion about upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I see. Meals aren't just for health management;
they also help control stress.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Eating a banana parfait once in a while...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah. No, other things are fine too.
Like banana cake or something...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, don't change the subject!
Jeez. Hmph..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, after finishing our first meeting of the new year, Biwa Hayahide and I savored a banana parfait together."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Skill and technique, huh?
...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then let's start right away by
gathering the necessary materials.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's go over the Classic winners from the past 10 years,
as well as the trends in race developments."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, is that still not enough?
Then let us comb through 20 years' worth of documents.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I felt like I had said one word too many.
Still, it turned out to be a very productive session.
